title: Rebuilding Cassini · Saturn
note: An independent Lambert recreation of the Cassini assist sequence, not the flown mission. Arrival is about 479 days later. These solar coasts join at planet centers; the displayed 412.4 m/s is the ideal DSM. Its separate finite-radius exporter adds 1647.3 m/s in junction burns and totals 2060.5 m/s before Saturn capture. The downloads here contain the ideal Lambert coasts, not that finite-radius export.

trajectory_files.source: Saved full-precision solar coast initial conditions
trajectory_files.note: Solar Kepler coasts with planet-center joins; not a resolved planetary flyby. Velocities jump at ideal encounters/DSMs. Samples bracket joins one second apart. Do not use planet-center passages for flyby close-up renders; use a finite-radius desktop export and check its additional burns.
